teams.blurb: What a win in Week 4. I said this team felt middling last week and A$AP Monke responded with 169.73 points in Week 4, the highest score of the season so far and the best week in franchise history. Ben is now 3-1, tied for the best record in the league, and leads Preach League in total points through four weeks. CeeDee Lamb went for 41.3 points, Kenneth Walker III added 30.9 points, and Kyle Monangai put up 28 points while filling in for Travis Etienne Jr. Now, ESPN projects this team to have a really awful week, with Lamar Jackson injured, Kenneth Walker III on bye, Travis Etienne Jr. still out, and Kyle Monangai now injured, so this top ranking very well might not last until Week 6. On the bright side, Ben matches up with Max in Week 5, the team projected to score the second least number of points on the week.

teams.synopsis: It’s been a little bit of a roller coaster of rankings for Andrew so far in 2026, back up to 2nd for the second time.
teams.blurb: It’s been a little bit of a roller coaster of rankings for Andrew so far in 2026, back up to 2nd for the second time. Last week I said the Andrew trade to replenish the RB room was a good one. One week later, Kyren Williams put up 36.7 points in his first start for N.Y. Routensss. Tetairoa McMillan went for 45.2 points, the best single-player performance of the season so far, and Andrew knocked off the number one team in the rankings with 150.45 points, the 4th best week in franchise history. The Tetairoa McMillan performance also ranks 4th all-time for best single-week performances in N.Y. Routensss history. He also set that lineup almost perfectly, leaving just 1 point on the bench, the best of anyone in Week 4. However, Week 5 is the Chiefs and Panthers bye, which means Andrew will be without a few key contributors. Week 5 is projected to be a tough one for the team, especially since Ryan has won the last three meetings between the two teams, but let’s see if the team can show some fight.

teams.synopsis: Well he didn’t increase his output by another 30 points in Week 4, but 108.02 is still a fine amount even with the loss.
teams.blurb: Well he didn’t increase his output by another 30 points in Week 4, but 108.02 is still a fine amount even with the loss. Baylen came up 1.11 points short against SheLoveQuigs in Week 4, the closest game of the week and closest game of Baylen’s Preach Fantasy career. Through four weeks Baylen is 2nd in the league in points per week at 127.6 points, just behind Ben. Jaxon Smith-Njigba was finally quiet with 12.6 points, but Brock Bowers (20.6) and Brock Purdy (19.6) picked up the slack, even if it was still not enough for the win. Michael Wilson has looked incredible, could he be in store for a top 15 wide receiver season? ESPN has Baylen as one of the highest projected teams in Week 5 against a Rolls With Butter squad that has dropped in scoring every single week, and Baylen has won the last three meetings between the two. I expect the team to be 3-2 this time next week.

teams.synopsis: A hiccup in Week 4 causes Charlie to fall out of the top spot once again.
teams.blurb: A hiccup in Week 4 causes Charlie to fall out of the top spot once again. No Fox Gibbs’en put up 100.78 points against Andrew and lost by almost 50, but the frustrating part was and continues to be what happens on the bench. This team has the depth that I keep talking about, I mean they are 3rd in the depth metric I engineered, but the issue is utilizing it. Still, I’m not panicking. ESPN projects this team for the most points per week the rest of the season (121.3), and Charlie is projected to have one of the easier strengths of schedules from here on out. Chuba Hubbard, a key contributor, is on bye in Week 5, but Charlie gets Deniz, a manager he has beaten in four straight regular season meetings. He may not sit atop the rankings heading into Week 5, but Charlie will surely be a mainstay in the top five for the rest of 2026.

teams.synopsis: This fall is less about Aidan’s team, they actually had a fine Week 4 performance with 109.13 points, but more so about the teams ahead.
teams.blurb: This fall is less about Aidan’s team, they actually had a fine Week 4 performance with 109.13 points, but more so about the teams ahead. The team finally won their first Matchup of the Week after losing both the Week 1 and Week 2 prime time games. Aidan has scored between 109 and 134 points every week this season, the highest weekly floor in the league, which is kind of what you look for in contenders. Also, according to my depth metric Aidan has the deepest team in the league, in a tier of his own followed by Ben and Charlie. Week 5 brings Quin, and while ESPN projects Aidan to win this matchup cleanly, the all-time record between these two is dead even 3-3 and Quin has won the last two meetings.

teams.synopsis: Despite the loss in Week 4, I’m moving myself up six spots.
teams.blurb: Despite the loss in Week 4, I’m moving myself up six spots. My team scored 153.98 points in Week 4, the 2nd highest losing score in Preach League regular season history, behind only Ben’s 166.06-point loss in Week 3 of 2023. Emanuel Wilson (27.0), Zay Flowers (25.8) and C.J. Stroud (23.1) led the way, and the Omarion Hampton problem is now Anthony’s problem. Week 5 is a 3-3 all-time matchup with Carmine, though I’ve won the last three meetings. ESPN projects it to be a semi-close matchup, so we’ll see if I can put up another great performance but get the win this time.

A controversial fall? I don’t think so, but after the reactions to Anthony’s trade I assume he’ll be back up this list very soon. Last week I called out that Anthony’s scoring had dropped every week. Week 4 kept the trend going in the worst way possible. Rolls With Butter has gone from 140.31 to 129.07 to 104.16 to 75.47 points, and that 75.47 performance was the lowest score of the week, the 4th lowest in franchise history, and a loss to the lowest scoring team in the league in 2026. Not a great weekend of fantasy football I’d say. It’s a tough spot in Week 5 against a top team, projected to lose by over 10 points, and Baylen has won the last three meetings. Hopefully the defending champion can turn it around in Week 5.

teams.synopsis: Carmine deserves to move up a spot in the rankings after the great performance in Week 4, but on the season the team has still disappointed.
teams.blurb: Carmine deserves to move up a spot in the rankings after the great performance in Week 4, but on the season the team has still disappointed. Carmine is 12th in the league in total points and has had the 3rd fewest points scored against him, so a lot of that 3-1 start is the schedule. In Week 4, Nico Collins (30.8) and Bijan Robinson (27.7) did the heavy lifting for Carmine to earn his third win of the season. It looks like the team will be without Breece Hall for yet another week, but the matchup shouldn’t be that difficult. Let’s see if Carmine can continue his winning start, something he’s done plenty of times before.

teams.synopsis: Ryan sits at 1-3, the first time in seven seasons he’s won fewer than two of his first four games.
teams.blurb: Ryan sits at 1-3, the first time in seven seasons he’s won fewer than two of his first four games. The team is 8th in the league in points per week (112.0), so this isn’t a bottom-of-the-league roster, but the margin for error is shrinking. On the bright side, ESPN projects Ryan to win in Week 5 against N.Y. Routensss, a team that will be without Patrick Mahomes, Travis Kelce and Tetairoa McMillan. Ryan has won five of the seven meetings between the two, including the last three. I believe Ryan must cash in this week to avoid starting 1-4, especially with Aaron Jones Sr. getting the workhorse load that he’s been getting. Make “Make Fantasy Great Again” great again.

teams.synopsis: 2026 has honestly been better to Deniz than I expected it to be.
teams.blurb: 2026 has honestly been better to Deniz than I expected it to be. Deniz picked up the second win of the season in Week 4 to move to 2-2, the 4th time in franchise history the team has won at least two of its first four games. It wasn’t quite the boom week I was hoping for, 102.45 points and a 1.23-point win over Cole, but a win is a win. Alvin Kamara (22.8) and Carnell Tate (21.5) led the way, while Bucky Irving only managed 6.1 points in that juicy matchup. The team is still only 11th in points per week, so I can’t put them much higher than this, but with what’s expected to be a high-scoring affair this week against a top team, I think Deniz has a real shot to move up many spots in the Week 6 rankings.

teams.synopsis: I didn’t know where to place this team this week, you could honestly swap Cole and Brandon’s rankings, but I personally have Cole ahead.
teams.blurb: I didn’t know where to place this team this week, you could honestly swap Cole and Brandon’s rankings, but I personally have Cole ahead. Cole has scored between 101 and 121 points every week, never really out of a game, but sits at 1-3, with two of those losses coming by a combined 4.89 points. The trade rumors I mentioned last week didn’t turn into anything yet, but the team would benefit from turning some of that bench depth into a starter. Week 5 is a good chance to get back on track against a team that has dropped in scoring every week, and Cole has won the last three meetings between the two. The team should really be viewed more towards the middle of the league in my opinion, but perhaps after Week 5 they will be.

teams.synopsis: It’s been a downward trend points-wise since Week 1, with Brandon putting up a season-low 95.67 points in Week 4.
teams.blurb: It’s been a downward trend points-wise since Week 1, with Brandon putting up a season-low 95.67 points in Week 4. A week after making his first trade of the season it looks like Brandon may have gotten the lesser of the two sides of the trade, especially with T.J. Hockenson looking like a viable TE option and Jalen Coker sitting on Brandon’s bench for a second straight week. After two straight losses, I now expect Brandon to struggle once again against Cole in Week 5. Big performances will most likely be needed from both Jonathan Taylor and Jaylen Warren for The Minutemen to walk away with a positive record. 2026 has statistically been Brandon’s worst season since 2020, averaging less than 113 points for the first time since then, 108 points per game this season. Huge Week 5 for the team, evident by the Matchup of the Week below.

teams.synopsis: Despite being one of only two teams to average less than 100 points per matchup through four weeks, Quin is 2-2 after picking up his second win of the season in Week 4.
teams.blurb: Despite being one of only two teams to average less than 100 points per matchup through four weeks, Quin is 2-2 after picking up his second win of the season in Week 4. The team just hasn’t shown a ceiling yet that is appealing to me or even just one that says, “I’m a playoff team”. The big three of Malik Nabers, Chase Brown, and Quinshon Judkins all showed up in Week 4, but they’ll need to keep doing that in the coming weeks for Quin to stay afloat, especially with Devonta Smith missing some time. The matchup in Week 5 is projected to be a tough one, about a 15-point spread, though Quin has shown an ability to win tough matchups despite the projections. The lineup is gross, but Quin has yet to make a trade this season and he’s never had less than three trades in a single season so I expect the lineup to look different by Week 6 or 7.

teams.synopsis: Max earned his second win of the season in Week 4, he beat Ryan by less than two points which is the second time in 2026 that Max has won by less than two.
teams.blurb: Max earned his second win of the season in Week 4, he beat Ryan by less than two points which is the second time in 2026 that Max has won by less than two. This team ranks 13th in points per week, so despite the 2-2 record I still have to see more from this team to move them up the rankings. The Saquon Barkley injury stinks, but he hasn’t been helpful this season anyway. Max will have to lean on his wide receivers once again to earn his third win of the season. Fortunately for Max, he faces off against Ben in week 5 who’s also projected to score less than 100 points. We will be watching Tee Higgins injury reports very closely ahead of Week 5, but even if he plays this matchup will most likely be a good ole fashion bot-off. The schedule has been kind to the team, let’s see if that continues in Week 5.

matchup_of_the_week.blurb: Not the flashiest Matchup of the Week on paper, but it may be the most important one. As I said in Cole’s blurb, you could swap these two in the rankings, so Week 5 settles it. Cole leads the all-time series 5-3, including a win in the 2023 playoffs, and has won the last three meetings, highlighted by a 188.74-point performance in Week 7 of 2025, the 2nd highest regular season score in league history. Brandon has scored fewer points every week this season, while Cole has lost two games by a combined 4.89 points. The loser falls to 2-3 or 1-4, and I think Cole gets back on track here and makes next week’s rankings an easy call.
